changes: Added tools/freebsd/report_removable_media_local_fallback_host_proof_imports.py to classify the checked-in FreeBSD proof import root as complete, degraded legacy-only, blocked/empty, or invalid.

Refactored the checked import-root gate to print proof_status, proof_complete, primary_production_real_host_proof, and real_host_proof counts instead of letting an empty root look like product completion.
Refactored the real-host operator packet so sealed archive inspection and loose-directory import are separate paths, then added status-report commands to same-host and cloudtainer import flows.
Updated current docs, README, changelog, generated cube summaries, schema consts, and front-door index while keeping docs/00-index.md under its line/byte budget.
Added an r606 lesson: structural audit is not product proof; empty proof roots should report blocked with explicit counts.
focus: make the real FreeBSD proof gap explicit and operator-visible without adding another registry layer

proof_status.note: archive release is r606; the FreeBSD host-proof target matrix/contract version remains r605 because the target matrix itself did not change in this revision.

still_open: validation/freebsd-host-proof-imports remains empty; no real FreeBSD host proof is checked in.
Next scarce-host milestone remains: collect, seal, import, audit, and report one primary-production FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE proof handoff.
The reporter intentionally returns nonzero with --fail-if-incomplete until that primary-production proof exists.
substance_over_bureaucracy: No new schema was added for the proof-status reporter; it reuses the existing strict import auditor and emits a small deterministic status object.
The new gate turns the riskiest incomplete item into a plainly visible status line while preserving the existing release-critical profile size at 49 checks.
The operator packet now reduces manual choreography risk for the next scarce host run instead of adding a new doctrine page.
